plan.name: real-app
plan._comment: FrameConsole (run with --host <sender IP>, 127.0.0.1 when the generator runs on the sender PC). One broadcast, source quality only; every viewer also holds the chat socket and 5% send 6 messages/min. Hold 45 s per stage for fast iteration (not a capacity soak; use soak.json for that). Target statistics come only from the app's read-only GET /api/stats (contract v 1): session count, send rate, the source ingest rate as the full-rate reference, and the stop rules (degraded-below-min, success-below-min, whep-503-share, generator-cpu / host-cpu / host-memory). The stages past this PC's loopback limit (~50-75 viewers of 8 Mbit/s) stay in the file on purpose: the stop rules end the run there. Traffic cap 40 GB covers all planned stages (~16 GB at 8.6 Mbit/s, ~23 GB at 12 Mbit/s), so it never cuts a planned stage. Browser pages (1 desktop + 1 mobile-like, 20 s) run only in a separate phase after the holds of stages 1 and 10, never inside a hold.

definitions.viewer: one WebRTC peer (MediaMTX WHEP source in the generator process): ICE + DTLS-SRTP + RTCP, receives and depacketizes H.264/Opus, no decoding or rendering
definitions.receiving: received bytes grew by more than 0 kbit/s in a 2000 ms sample window
definitions.firstMedia: join requested (ramp slot, burst start or churn re-join; queueing included) -> the viewer's generator path has media: ready, with tracks and received bytes. The time is the path ready time (tracks gathered = first RTP) when it is a real time not before the request; MediaMTX's zero-year placeholder and earlier times are ignored. Without a usable ready time the sample clock is used and counted in firstMediaMs.basis / firstMediaFromSampleClock (error up to one sample interval).
definitions.reconnect: media again after a loss, or a new real ready time of the same session; the placeholder -> real ready time transition is not a reconnect
definitions.sustained: first media and receiving in >= 95% of the hold windows; successRate = sustained / requested
definitions.fullRate: sustained, and every quality segment the viewer watched in the hold (>= 4 s) has a mean rate >= 90% of that quality's reference (reference.<quality>.from); fullRateSuccessRate = full-rate viewers / (requested or sessions seen) minus sessions too short to judge (fullRateTooShort, all segments < minSegmentSec), not measured when a watched quality has no reference (an idle path's ingest 0 is no reference)
definitions.fullRateLive: per sample: share of viewers whose rolling 10 s rate is >= 90% of their quality's rolling reference (stop rule degraded-below-min)
definitions.stall: a 2000 ms window without growth (<= 0 kbit/s); stallTimeRatio = stalled time / observed time after first media
definitions.cpuPct: percent of the whole machine (all logical CPUs) from process CPU time; cores = same in CPU cores
definitions.unattributedCpuPct: host CPU minus generator, target and browser-sampler processes: other programs and kernel network time; a stage is flagged externalLoad when its hold mean is above 25%
definitions.rtpPacketsLost: losses reported by the generator WebRTC sources (MediaMTX log, "1 RTP packet lost" and "N RTP packets lost"); lossRatioEst assumes ~1,150 B per RTP packet
definitions.whep: WHEP signalling seen by the loopback tap (status per offer, Retry-After values); MediaMTX's WHEP client itself retries about every 5 s whatever Retry-After says
definitions.traffic: bytes received by the generator's protocol viewers (browser pages not counted)
definitions.network: generator and target location are recorded in host/target; loopback or same-PC traffic does not cross the NIC

notMeasured: decoded FPS, rendering, A/V sync, player rebuffering and live latency are not measured by protocol viewers (see browser sampler fields)
target-side dropped frame counts: only the app count of MediaMTX "too slow, discarding" warnings (appDiscardWarnings)

trafficPlan.note: protocol viewers only (browser pages and chat not counted); per-viewer rate = the mix of the plan's qualities

stages.rebuffering: stall windows only (byte growth); player rebuffering not measured

definitions.firstFrameMs: page navigation start -> first presented video frame (requestVideoFrameCallback), includes page load, WHEP/ICE and first keyframe
definitions.presentedFps: presented frames per second in the window (rVFC)
definitions.latencyMs: barcode stamp (source wall clock) -> expected display time; needs a shared clock
definitions.decodedFps: framesDecoded delta / stats-timestamp delta of the main connection: over the window, or from the first decoded frame when the connection was made inside the window (decodedFpsBasis)
definitions.profiles: desktop = the window as started; mobile = DevTools emulation (390x844, DPR 3, touch, Android UA) in desktop Edge: mobile-like layout and quality choice, not a phone decoder or mobile network

pages.decodedFpsBasis: connection created inside the window: from its first decoded frame
